rules: Mall directory finds tenants; store pages confirm branch events; brand/manufacturer campaigns are leads only.
Resolve branches first; do not manufacture one source per town for a chain with no confirmed branch.
Public child program eligibility, membership, capacity and numerical ages are separate fields.
Do not treat ordinary shopping, discounts, private parties or animal adoption paperwork as toddler programming.
Use local NGO/rescue partner calendars for pet-store educational or family activities; verify outsider access separately.
